postload_actions.speaker: BAAL
postload_actions.text: MILDLY IMPRESSIVE! FEW HAVE PENETRATED THE PRICKLY SHELL OF OUR SUCCULENT EXECUTIVE SUITES.

postload_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
postload_actions.text: Executive? Does that mean... I've reached your evil lair?
postload_actions.cage: And I'M like a prickly PEAR!

postload_actions.speaker: BAAL
postload_actions.text: YEAH, NO, IT'S MOSTLY JUST THE DRAGON IN HERE. HE'S MIDDLE-MANAGEMENT, SEE.

postload_actions.speaker: BAAL
postload_actions.text: LOOK YOU NEED TO STOP SWEATING EVERY TIME I REVEAL SOMETHING. YOU'RE LEAVING PUDDLES, IT'S GROSS AND IT'S A HEALTH RISK.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: The machine is out of order - but let's take a look at the offerings.

PAINDEMON BAR 
 The ONLY Candy Bar with the ear-splitting howl!

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: ...I'll pass.
default_actions.cage: I was saving it because I got nauseated by that pre-cooked mini-mall rotisserie chicken...

DEATHTOLLHAUS COOKIES

default_actions.text: ...I'll pass.

GUMMI BAAL 
 A NOVELTY GELATIN PA SYSTEM SO REALISTIC THAT YOU'D ALMOST BE FORGIVEN FOR THINKING I WAS SPEAKING TO YOU THROUGH IT RIGHT NOW.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: ...I'll pass.
default_actions.cage: I was saving it because I got nauseated by that pre-cooked mini-mall rotisserie chicken...

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: THAT STANDS FOR, UH... MAGNANIMOUS TYRANT! PROBABLY.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Excuse me... are you the custodian?
default_actions.cage: Could I get my prescription, PLEASE?

default_actions.text: Hrmph. How's about I answer youse question, with another question?
Say you're walkin' the cubicle beat, and some Mindflayer from HR just belched 5 tons of wet nightmare on the lineoleum.
Whaddya do about a thing like that?
Walk around it
default_actions.label: walkaround

default_actions.text: Grab a mop
default_actions.label: mop

default_actions.text: Pour sawdust on it
default_actions.label: sawdust

default_actions.text: Close your eyes & hope it disappears
default_actions.label: ignore

default_actions.text: Sure. You walk away. It's hell, right? Can't make the place smell any worse. Who's gonna mind?
Well, I mind, son. I'd rather run a clean ship in hell than poke around a sty in heaven.
Ah, the good ol' elbow grease method! I could see in your eyes that you were a hard worker, kid.
...of course, Mindflayer vomit is highly combustible, so the broom'd catch on fire and sear your arms off.
Hmm. I suppose you're the type to solve every problem by pulling some trick out o' your inventory. Is that right?
Shame that adding sawdust to Mindflayer vomit would cause a chemical reaction with th' intensity of twelve exploding suns.
Not a terrible idea, actually. Mindflayer vomit is 95% imaginary, so not thinking about it is better than doin' nothing.
...but the last 5% is always the hardest to clean up. You might just learn that, someday.
You got a lot to learn, kid. But you remind me of myself when I was just a wee bouncin' ball.

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: The name's TONY. I fix things what need fixin', and clean things what need cleanin'.

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: Now, if you'll excuse me - that ol' OUT OF ORDER sign is blinkin' my name...

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: What can I do ya fer, son?
Ask about the elevator
default_actions.label: AskElevator

default_actions.text: Ask about the bathroom
default_actions.label: AskBathroom

default_actions.text: Ask about the projector
default_actions.label: AskProjector

default_actions.text: Ask about the vending machine
default_actions.label: AskVending

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: The elevator seems to be out of order.

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: I'd heard as much! Apparently the doors are being sealed by a sinister unseen force. Pretty standard stuff.

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: It's next on my list - but first I gotta fix this here vending machine. And at this rate, it might take a few decades.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: D-d-decades?

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: D-D-D-DUH, YOU'RE IN HELL. WAIT 'TIL YOU SEE HOW LONG IT TAKES TO FILL OUT A TIMESHEET DOWN HERE.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: It seems there was an exceedingly gory plumbing mishap...

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: I'm aware, son. Seems like it'll just be a matter of finding the leak and plugging it up with whatever happens to be on hand.

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: 'Course, that's more of a job for a professional plumber, in my opinion.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Is there - is there a demon plumber that I should try and track down?

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: ALL PLUMBERS GO TO HEAVEN! EVERYONE KNOWS THAT.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: The slide show in the conference room hit some kind of snag...

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: Slide... show? Listen, this new-fangled mumbo jumbo is beyond this cowboy's ken.

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: You'll want to twist the IT Guy's ear about that one. Last I heard, he was imprisoned by middle management in the next room over.

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: Something about a web? An inner-net? I'm sure it involved all kinds o' cutting edge punch cards an' vaccuum tubes.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: So what's up with the vending machine?

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: Well, as you can see, there's a poltergeist haunting the upper rows, there.

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: It's strange, though - none of the sanctifying fluids I use for evil spirits bother this guy.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: CONFIDENTIALLY I THINK THAT GHOST DID YOU A FAVOR. PAUNCH-CHINKO MAN.

default_actions.speaker: TONY
default_actions.text: Anything else, son?
Describe more problems
default_actions.label: Options

default_actions.text: Leave Tony to his mopping
default_actions.label: DoneTalking

stapler.speaker: TONY
stapler.text: I'll polish your office supplies another time, kid. Bit busy at the moment.

scissors.speaker: TONY
scissors.text: I'll polish your office supplies another time, kid. Bit busy at the moment.

lens.speaker: TONY'S THOUGHTS
lens.text: I can weild this here mop 'til the cows come home, but as long as HE roams free... Ball Hell will never truly be clean...

default_actions.text:
Mumble mumble E-MAILS... 
 Grumbe grumble FIREWALL...

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Hnnghh... I can hear voices on the other side, but the door won't budge.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Maybe I need someone to buzz me in?

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: ANOTHER THEORY. YOUR SUBCONSCIOUS IS PREVENTING YOU FROM OPENING THAT DOOR BECAUSE, IN YOUR HEART OF HEARTS...

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: YOU KNOW YOU SHOULD BE IN YOUR CUBICLE, WORKING ON NEXT TUESDAY'S REPORTS.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: THIS IS A JOURNEY OF SELF-DISCOVERY WE CAN EMBARK ON TOGETHER. IT'S CALLED, 'GET BACK TO WORK, YOU SLACKER'.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: I think I hear voices coming from in there... maybe I should get closer.

default_actions.speaker: VENDINGHEIST
default_actions.text:
Hum de dum ~ 
 Candied rainbows, gumdrops too 
 'Tater chips and chocolate stew

default_actions.speaker: VENDINGHEIST
default_actions.text:
Though the snacks are overpriced 
 Enticed, I am 
 The vendingheist ~

default_actions.text: WHAT! WHO LEFT THESE SHREDS OF PAPER ALL OVER THE PLACE? ALL SHREDS OF PAPER MUST BE COLLATED AND PROPERLY FILED.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: These don't seem like ordinary shreds of paper...
default_actions.cage: How could someone MISfile something? How could it be easier, it's all alphabetical!

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: ADMIRING YOUR HANDIWORK, EH? BETTER PACK HER BODY INTO SOME ENVELOPES AND MAIL HER TO YOUR KILL SPOT, YOU MONSTER.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: H-hey, she's not dead! It's totally reversible!

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: JEEZE, LEARN TO TAKE A COMPLIMENT.

default_actions.text: You're SURE that you REALLY have an appointment?
YES
NO

YES

default_actions.speaker: Origami-tan
default_actions.text: So um, word of warning. Mr. Drachenroe is a nice guy, but he has a bit of a temper. And if he gets mad at you, then he WILL fry you.

default_actions.speaker: Origami-tan
default_actions.text: Avoid making eye contact, he sees that as a challenge to his dominance. Actually, just stay out of his range of vision completely.

default_actions.speaker: Origami-tan
default_actions.text: Apart from that, so long as you don't talk, make sudden movements, or emit any threatening odors...

default_actions.speaker: Origami-tan
default_actions.text: He's a big ol' pussy cat ~

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: *gulp*

default_actions.speaker: Origami-tan
default_actions.text: Then, umm... why did you come over here? Were you just looking for an excuse to talk to me~

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: N-no! Not that you're not, um... attractively folded...
default_actions.cage: A young woman called out to me - nobody wants to date me! Again, I'm going to bed alone, again!

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: HEY HEY HEY! INTRA-OFFICE ROMANCE IS EXPRESSLY FORBIDDEN! SEE, THIS IS WHY WE NEED TO START SPAYING AND NEUTERING MISBEGOTTEN SOULS.

default_actions.speaker: Origami-tan
default_actions.text:
You... you're just a big liar, aren't you?! 
 ...I guess that's why you're in hell. Tee hee ~

default_actions.speaker: Origami-tan
default_actions.text: Oh hey, I almost forgot! I have, like, a quest for you, Mr. Pachinko Man.

default_actions.speaker: Origami-tan
default_actions.text:
I would like you... 
 ...to have an AWESOME DAY ~

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: D'aww, thank you, Origami-tan!

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: GOOD DAYS ARE EXPRESSLY FORBIDDEN! DID YOU PEOPLE EVEN READ THE EMPLOYEE HANDBOOK?!

stapler.speaker: ORIGAMI-TAN
stapler.text: OMG! I'm like, alive again 'n junk!

stapler.speaker: BAAL
stapler.text: IT'S A STAPLER, NOT A HANDGUN! TRY GETTING CLOSER, GOOFUS.

stapler.speaker: ORIGAMI-TAN
stapler.text: OMG! I'm like... still alive. Huh. Fun!

scissors.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
scissors.cage: I'm sorry I was such a saint before, and uh... I'm such a PRICK now.

scissors.speaker: BAAL
scissors.text: WHAT'RE YOU GONNA DO, MAKE PAPER SNOWFLAKES?! ARTS AND CRAFTS HAVE NO PLACE IN HELL, FOOLISH MORTAL!

scissors.speaker: BAAL
scissors.text: ...BESIDES, YOU DON'T EVEN HAVE ANY GLITTER PAINT.

scissors.speaker: BAAL
scissors.text: UNLESS YOU PLAN ON USING THOSE AS A MAKESHIFT BOOMERANG OF SOME KIND YOU SHOULD PROBABLY GET A LITTLE CLOSER.

lens.speaker: ORIGAMI-TAN'S THOUGHTS
lens.text: Hmm... got to dedicate all of my spare brainpower to remembering Mr. Drachenroe's secrets for him.

lens.speaker: ORIGAMI-TAN'S THOUGHTS
lens.text:
Owns more than seven cats... 
 Hides embezzled treasure hoard under his bed... 
 Needs meds to breathe fire these days...

lens.speaker: ORIGAMI-TAN'S THOUGHTS
lens.text:
Has a crippling fear of loneliness... 
 His Wi-fi password is ProudCatDad73... 
 Did I forget anything?

hatemail.speaker: ORIGAMI-TAN
hatemail.text:
OMG, what? What EVEN. Nobody ever steals supplies from this side of the office, silly! 
 Or... visits, this side of the office.

hatemail.speaker: ORIGAMI-TAN
hatemail.text: You think they're afraid of the dog? He's so sweet 'n harmless, though! As long as you don't have any blood. Or tears ducts.
